title: Research: prove a sparse P112 completion rank law through 52-port blocks
body:
For an arbitrary complex correction Q supported on at most 52 P112 rows and 52 columns, rank(2G + E_A*Q*E_B^t) = 8 + rank(Q). The proof derives root-code minimum support 53 under the retained E8 flat-classification premise. Exact matching/rectangle controls and a correctly labeled unmasked 53-support rank-drop example delimit the result. This bounds total rank-one factors, including free terms, rather than paid copy cost.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f784a84bbe80879b5bd7ae9b48dd28a5765863d/research/p112-sparse-completion-rank/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
